passwordReset.subject: Reset your School of Gaming password
passwordReset.heading: Reset Your Password
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your School of Gaming password. Click the button below to choose a new password.
passwordReset.expiry: This link will expire in 1 hour.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn’t request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not be changed.

pinReset.subject: Reset your School of Gaming parent PIN
pinReset.heading: Reset Your Parent PIN
pinReset.body: We received a request to reset the PIN for your School of Gaming parent account. Click the button below to choose a new 4-digit PIN.
pinReset.expiry: This link will expire in 24 hours.
pinReset.ignore: If you didn’t request a PIN reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your PIN will not be changed.

helpRequest.subject: Help request from {displayName} ({role})
helpRequest.heading: New help request
helpRequest.intro: Someone has asked for help. Reply to this email to answer them — your reply goes to the address below.
helpRequest.gamerNoteNoMailbox: Sent from {firstName}’s gamer account, which has no email of its own.
helpRequest.gamerNoteOwnMailbox: Sent from {firstName}’s gamer account — they also read their own email, {gamerEmail}.

welcomeParent.subject: Welcome to School of Gaming
welcomeParent.heading: Welcome to School of Gaming
welcomeParent.greeting: Hi {firstName}, and welcome. We’re glad you’re here.
welcomeParent.platform: Sogverse is School of Gaming’s platform, where you manage your family’s clubs, camps and events.
welcomeParent.verifyBody: Verifying your email address lets us reach you about your family’s clubs. You can do it now, or later from your {settingsLink}.

welcomeGedu.subject: Welcome to School of Gaming – your Gedu account
welcomeGedu.heading: Welcome to School of Gaming
welcomeGedu.greeting: Hi {firstName}, and thank you for registering as a Gedu.
welcomeGedu.certification: An admin will look over your account and certify it. You can get started in My SOG in the meantime, though some parts of the platform stay locked until your account is certified.
welcomeGedu.verifyBody: Verifying your email address lets us reach you about your groups and sessions. You can do it now, or later from your {settingsLink}.

productConfirmation.heading: You’re in!

waitlist.subheading: You’re on the waitlist for {productName}. We’ll let you know if a seat opens.

next2.consumer_club: You keep your place in line for the whole term.
next2.municipality_club: You keep your place in line for the whole term.
next2.camp: You keep your place in line for the camp.
next2.event: You keep your place in line for the event.

next.sessions: You’ll find {participantName}’s sessions under My SOG.
next.sessionsSelf: You’ll find your sessions under My SOG.
next.sessionsOnline: {participantName} joins the sessions online in My SOG. The voice room opens {minutes} minutes before each session starts.
next.sessionsOnlineSelf: You join the sessions online in My SOG. The voice room opens {minutes} minutes before each session starts.
next.subscription: You’ll be billed every month. You can manage or cancel anytime from My SOG.
next.upfront: This was a one-time payment — there’s nothing more to pay.
next.firstCharge: Nothing was charged today. Your first payment is on {date}.
next.firstSessionSelf: Your first session is on {date} at {time}.
next.guarantee: If the club isn’t right for {participantName}, write to us within 30 days of their first session and we’ll refund everything you’ve paid towards it.
next.guaranteeSelf: If the club isn’t right for you, write to us within 30 days of your first session and we’ll refund everything you’ve paid towards it.

waitlist.subject: {participantName} is on the waitlist for {productName}
waitlist.subjectSelf: You are on the waitlist for {productName}
waitlist.heading: You’re on the waitlist
waitlist.subheading: {participantName} is on the waitlist for {productName}. We’ll let you know if a seat opens.
waitlist.next1: We’ll email you the moment a seat opens.

next2.consumer_club: {participantName} keeps their place in line for the whole term.
next2.municipality_club: {participantName} keeps their place in line for the whole term.
next2.camp: {participantName} keeps their place in line for the camp.
next2.event: {participantName} keeps their place in line for the event.

waitlist.next3: You can keep track of your waitlist spot anytime in My SOG.

invite.whereOnline: Sessions run online in My SOG, and the voice room opens {minutes} minutes before each session starts.
invite.link: Everything about this signup is in My SOG: {url}

productConfirmation.closing: Questions? Just reply to this email, or write to {supportEmail}.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.body: Hi {firstName}, you asked us to verify the email address on your School of Gaming account. Use the button below to confirm it.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you didn’t ask for this, you can safely ignore this email. Nothing will change.

gamerWelcome.subject: Your School of Gaming account is ready
gamerWelcome.heading: Your account is ready
gamerWelcome.body: Hi {gamerName}, your parent set up a School of Gaming account for you. To sign in you need a password — first, tap the button to confirm this is your email, then you can choose one.
gamerWelcome.ignore: If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it. Nothing will happen.

sessionReport.subject: Session report – {productName}, {sessionDate}
sessionReport.title: Session report
sessionReport.gamerIntro: Hi {gamerName}! Here’s {geduName}’s report from your {productName} session.
sessionReport.closing: This report, the earlier ones and the upcoming sessions are all on the {productName} page in My SOG.
sessionReport.staffCopyBody: This is a copy of the session report that went to the group’s families. You are reading it as the person who sent it, or as an admin, not as a parent.
sessionReport.staffCopyPrivacy: Every family received their own separate email, addressed to them alone. The Gedu and admin addresses in this copy’s To and Cc lines appear on this copy only: no parent sees them, and no family sees another family.

seatOffer.heading: A seat has opened
seatOffer.question: Would you still like it? Let us know either way — a no helps just as much, because it lets us offer the place to the next family straight away.
seatOffer.deadlineBody: {deadline}. If we have not heard from you by then, the seat goes to the next family in line.
seatOffer.alsoInMySog: The same question is waiting for you in My SOG, if you would rather answer there.

child.subject: {participantName}: a seat has opened in {productName}
child.opening: We promised to write the moment a seat opened. It has: {participantName} can join us — {productName}.

self.subject: A seat has opened in {productName}
self.opening: We promised to write the moment a seat opened. It has: you can join us — {productName}.

gamer.subject: A seat has opened for you in {productName}
gamer.opening: Hi {gamerName}, a seat has opened up for you in {productName}. That is good news.
gamer.parentDecides: Your parent has an email asking them to say yes or no, and they have until {deadline}. Once they answer, you will see it in My SOG.

seatOfferStaff.nextStep: The offer is over and the seat is open again. Open the product to see who is in line and send the next invitation.

declined.subject: {participantName} declined a seat in {productName}
declined.heading: A seat offer was declined
declined.body: This family cannot take the seat, and they told us rather than leaving it hanging. They have been taken off the waitlist.

no_response.subject: No answer to a seat offer for {participantName} in {productName}
no_response.heading: A seat offer ran out
no_response.body: The response window closed with no answer. The family is still on the waitlist and can be offered the seat again, but the seat itself is free right now.
